FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Asset Exporter & Database Builder (ffr-export)
Usage: ffr-export [--lang en|zh-Hans|ja] Start the interactive database build wizard ffr-export build-db --game <dir> --usmap <file> [options] Export game data and build ffr.sqlite via ffr-db ffr-export fetch-usmap --game <dir> [--timeout <sec>] [--yes] Automatically dump .usmap for the installed game ffr-export uninstall-ue4ss --game <dir> [--include-foreign] [--yes] Clean up UE4SS and temporary remnants installed by this tool ffr-export list | raw | export | locres | inventory | export-assets | export-maps Staged export and diagnostic subcommands ffr-export --help | -h | help Show this help message
Global options: --lang en|zh-Hans|ja Select interface language (default: en; for 'locres', pass --lang before 'locres') --progress-json Emit machine-readable @@progress JSON lines (used by the GUI; build-db / fetch-usmap)
